matt: Desert-island lunch poll: you can only have ONE lunch item forever — what do you pick? make it count. i'll start: burrito 🌯
anita: sushi 🍣 — freshness forever
devin: pizza slice (NY style) 🍕 obviously
nico: salad bowl? gotta have greens 🥗 (i know it's weird)
sara: peanut butter sandwich. protein + shelf-stable 🥪
matt: vote with emoji pls: :burrito: burrito, :pizza: pizza, :sushi: sushi, :sandwich: pb&j sandwich, :green_salad: salad
snackbot: Poll created — options: burrito, sushi, pizza, sandwich, salad. Current counts: burrito:1, sushi:1, pizza:1, sandwich:1, salad:1 (poll expires in 24h)
devin: also — unlimited condiments allowed? :eyes:
anita: only one item sticks. i'm team sushi forever. :sushi: :heart:
nico: tbh i'd go burrito if it has beans + rice. durable and tasty. :burrito:
sara: trade my vote for someone bringing chips later :stuck_out_tongue:
matt: counting quick tally: burrito 2, pizza 1, sushi 1, sandwich 1, salad 1 — burrito leads :tada:
sam: abstain — too many variables, can't decide :grimacing:
matt: ok this was fun. maybe round two: best travel-friendly snack? :thinking:
